It may be the darkness she carries within herself.

description:
Is Batman actually making Gotham WORSE? Bruce Wayne has billions of dollars, refuses to kill even the worst criminals, and repeatedly saves villains like the Joker. But what if Batman's moral code is doing more harm than good?

Check out my Graphic Novel on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/midnightddss/lady-midnight

Batman is one of the most celebrated superheroes in comic book history. But he's also one of the most controversial.

Why doesn't Bruce Wayne simply give away his money to solve Gotham's poverty? Why doesn't Batman kill the Joker, knowing he'll almost certainly escape and murder again? And when Batman saves an unrepentant mass murderer, can his mercy become an injustice to the innocent?

In this complete Batman video essay, we're examining three of the Dark Knight's greatest moral dilemmas:

BATMAN'S WEALTH: Can Bruce Wayne fix Gotham City with his billions? Or does Gotham's deeply rooted corruption make Batman a necessity?
